the development of molecular tools for the improvement of maize as a source of provitamin A, a micronutrient that is deficient in human diets in many parts of the world.

the identification of the most significant functional DNA markers for vitamin A levels in tropical maize germplasm, which can be used for breeding biofortified maize varieties for the developing world.
